description: Header file defining the Reducer class and related structures for distributed gradient reduction in PyTorch's distributed training. Contains class declarations, constants, and function prototypes related to gradient bucketing, communication hooks, and process group management.

classes.name: Reducer
classes.description: Manages gradient reduction, bucketing, and communication hooks for distributed training.

classes.name: Bucket
classes.description: Represents a bucket of gradients to be reduced together.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: Forward declaration, used for logging in distributed training.

methods.name: Reducer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the reducer with model parameters, process group, and configuration.

methods.description: Reinitializes bucket assignment with validation.

methods.name: autograd_hook
methods.description: Registers autograd hooks for a parameter index.

methods.name: prepare_for_backward
methods.description: Prepares the reducer for backward pass with model outputs.

methods.name: prepare_for_forward
methods.description: Captures start time at forward pass.

methods.name: get_backward_stats
methods.description: Returns timing stats for backward pass.

methods.description: Registers a custom communication hook.

methods.name: register_builtin_comm_hook
methods.description: Registers a built-in communication hook.

methods.name: set_optimizer_in_backward
methods.description: Informs reducer that optimizer step is in backward.

methods.name: run_comm_hook
methods.description: Executes communication hook for a gradient bucket.

methods.description: Executes default allreduce hook.

methods.name: install_futures
